name: phantra-ai
description: Work on your own images and clips with Claude: edit a still, cut out a subject, animate it, add a camera move or sound, upscale or reshape a clip, each quoted in credits and made only on your yes. Plan and price video scenes held to your photos, and trim, join and share. New images and video from a prompt are made in the Phantra studio, from a link with the prompt ready.
